newsitem.title: URUGUAY: Uruguay Nov 1996 trade deficit $113 mln.
newsitem.headline: Uruguay Nov 1996 trade deficit $113 mln.

text.p: Uruguay reported a $113 million trade deficit in November, down from a $122 million deficit in November 1995, but up from a $99.8 million deficit in October, the central bank said Friday.
Imports rose to $319 million in November from $275 million in the same month a year before.
Exports also climbed to $206 million in November from $153 million in November 1995.
In the first eleven months of 1996, Uruguay's trade deficit totaled $848.1 million, up from $672 million in the same period of 1995.
Between January and November, imports were $3.03 billion, against $2.61 billion in the first eleven months of the previous year.
Exports were $2.18 billion, compared with $1.94 billion in same period last year.
